name: Sparkling Blue Rhomboid Ioun Stone
source: Pathfinder #126: Beyond the Veiled Past pg. 51
body:
Source Pathfinder #126: Beyond the Veiled Past pg. 51
Aura strong varied CL 12th
Slot none; Price —; Weight —
Description
A sparkling blue rhomboid ioun stone grants a +4 enhancement bonus to Strength while in use.
Destruction
This stone can be destroyed like any other ioun stone, except it has AC 26, 50 hit points, and hardness 10.
